import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static long tri(long x) {
        return x * (x + 1) / 2;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int mod = sc.nextInt();

        int[][] comb = new int[n + 1][n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            comb[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                comb[i][j] = (int) ((comb[i - 1][j] + (long) comb[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod);
            }
        }

        long[] f = new long[n];
        long[] rest = new long[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int k = 0; k <= i; k++) {
                long cur = comb[i][k];
                long crst = 0;
                if (k > 0) {
                    crst = (crst * f[k - 1] + cur * rest[k - 1]) % mod;
                    cur = (cur * f[k - 1]) % mod;
                }
                if (k < i) {
                    crst = (crst * f[i - k - 1] + cur * rest[i - k - 1]) % mod;
                    cur = (cur * f[i - k - 1]) % mod;
                }
                rest[i] = (rest[i] + crst * (i + 2L) + cur * (tri(k) + tri(i - k))) % mod;
                f[i] = (f[i] + (i + 2L) * cur) % mod;
            }
        }

        long[][] dpF = new long[n + 1][m + 1];
        long[][] dpR = new long[n + 1][m + 1];
        dpF[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= i && j <= m; j++) {
                dpF[i][j] = dpF[i - 1][j];
                dpR[i][j] = dpR[i - 1][j];
                for (int k = 1; k <= j; k++) {
                    int prev = i - k;
                    if (prev > 0) --prev;
                    if (j - k <= prev) {
                        long val = (dpR[prev][j - k] * f[k - 1] + dpF[prev][j - k] * rest[k - 1]) % mod;
                        dpR[i][j] = (dpR[i][j] + comb[j][k] * val) % mod;
                        val = (dpF[prev][j - k] * f[k - 1]) % mod;
                        dpF[i][j] = (dpF[i][j] + comb[j][k] * val) % mod;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dpR[n][m]);
    }
}
